cohort: 150 pregnant women with intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (IHCP) who delivered at Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College and Hospital, Bhagalpur, Bihar from April 2023 to December 2023
finding: Elevated serum bile acid levels were significantly correlated with meconium stained liquor, NICU admission, and prematurity, but not with onset of labor or mode of delivery.
